main_text.head: Anno Domini.
main_text.l: 1280. Ægidius Romanus, a Trithemio author fuisse dicitur Compendii Theologicæ veritatis, quod pag. 193. Alberti Magni nomine citavimus. Idem opus Bonaventuræ nomine legitur in appendice septimi tomi operum ejus Romæ editorum.
1348. Johannes Andreas, author Glossarum in VI. Decretalium.
1438. Græcorum Apologia ad Basileense concilium de igne Purgatorio.

page.notes: Running head and page number are printed at the top; the signature VOL. III. and Q Q are at the foot. Some dates are printed with uncertain glyphs (e.g. 1320 and 1348) but read as shown.
